description: Bounties: prepare (unsigned) a bounty on a RIVAL crew (approve prize + the 5% fee first). The prize goes to the squad whose raid lands on that crew while it is open; it comes back to you after expiry if nobody collects (the fee stays in the pool). You cannot post on your own crew. At most 3 open at once; a prize above the minimum, 1 to 7 days, and at most 1,000,000 ZENI per call here.

prizeZeni.description: The prize in ZENI, for example "10000".

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_bounty_post
